time_and_split_coverage.time_basis: Header time for capture; bag time for later recording. These clocks are not interchangeable.
time_and_split_coverage.scope: Declared training split membership verified from actual saved config/transforms, not proof of how often every image was sampled by SGD. No image pixels read.

resumed_from.note: Restores model/optimizers/schedulers/scaler; image shuffle RNG is reseeded.

recorded.interpretation: Frozen historical appearance measurements and exported parameter equality remain valid. Completed loop count alone does not prove optimizer progress. Compare exact Adam counters with saved step; hard surface projection may still mutate means/quats without Adam updates.
recorded.scope: Only historical training_result.json files explicitly marking resumed_from were searched; one original block006 matched. No claim that every possible undocumented resume is detected.

historical_block006_correction.retained_statement: Loop step11999 / declared12000; six Adam counters11001. Do not claim12000 Adam updates or no training. Checkpoint optimizer tensors not reread in this coverage audit.

scope_limits: F1-F6 and ramps are inherited temporal labels, not independently validated physical floors.
Complete means all28 prepared collection regions represented once; spatial overlap among distinct regions remains.
Neither every bag message was used for training nor unobserved space proven complete.
No scores from different blocks or generations averaged into a full-scene score.
